When he's not acting, National Geographic 33 changemaker Harrison Ford is championing biodiversity. Through his words and his work, he urges us to find our own way into nature while respecting our place within it.

Learn more about his efforts to protect nature: https://go.natgeo.blink.app/3e3576

The National Geographic 33—inspired by our 33 founders—is an initiative honoring changemakers who are rising to meet the most critical challenges of our time, making meaningful progress and incredible breakthroughs.

author: National Geographic
description:
Follow along with agents across the United States as they crack down on illegal smuggling operations in this To Catch a Smuggler MEGA Episode. Featuring, three full episodes: 

Not My Meth
A mother crossing by car with her kids is caught smuggling cocaine in El Paso. AMO shoots out the engine of a boat loaded with coke in Puerto Rico.

Pots of Coke
HSI tracks a shipment of $12.6 million worth of cocaine hidden in gardening pots. CBP seizes illicit ammo and cash traveling to Mexico.

Coke and the Kids
HSI chases fleeing coke smugglers near a school. CBP finds shipments of pills, ketamine and counterfeit cash and stops knockoff shoes at the border.
